_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil statistics and absent thrust factors make HOLD the graded call; stay in Hope until Fear & Greed or momentum actually breaks the band.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both cautionary (analyst explicit CAUTION/HOLD; narrative describes Nasdaq weakness/VIX rise) but narrative does not affirm Hope phase or coil HOLD
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds ~60-72 and BTC remains range-bound without funding or 30d-momentum thrust
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks under ~55 with price accelerating lower and CVD suppressed (to Disbelief), or funding flips positive with Fear & Greed above ~75 and momentum reclaim (to Optimism)
